item: The custody bundle checker fails closed
refs: PR pending; Lane M route table (PR #1954)
summary: An export now carries a signed head (scope, entry count, last entry) signed by the entries' own key. verify_export refuses by name an empty bundle, a record cut short, a bundle without a signed head, a head re-signed or rewritten, and entries that do not match the head (a cut at the end). A one-item export, which used to fail, is checked entry by entry and says the links were not. The CLI refuses an unreadable file instead of a traceback.
